blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines —Concerns over incorrect farm-to-market road (FMR) coordinates had been blown out of proportion after the Department of Agriculture (DA) admitted that only eight of 1,669 projects in the proposed 2027 national budget contained errors. Camarines Sur 4th District Rep. Arnie Fuentebella issued that statement on Wednesday, pointing out that the eight projects represented less than 1 percent of the total and should not create the impression that the entire FMR program was riddled with mistakes. “There are just eight lang out of [more than] 1,600. It seems to be blown out of proportion. Like the whole budget or coordinates […]... Keep on reading: Farm-to-market road errors ‘blown out of proportion’ – House rep
